question: Find $k$ if $\begin{vmatrix}1&0&2\\2&1&3\\3&2&k\end{vmatrix}=5$. Verify the obtained value by direct expansion.
explanation:
Expansion along the first row
$$\begin{vmatrix}1&0&2\\2&1&3\\3&2&k\end{vmatrix}=1\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\2&k\end{vmatrix}+2\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\3&2\end{vmatrix}$$
Simplification
Therefore, the determinant equals $$(k-6)+2(4-3)=k-4$$
Determination of $k$
Using $k-4=5$, we obtain $$k=9$$
Verification
For $k=9$, the determinant is $9-4=5$. Hence, the required value is $k=9$.
